body:
m1 - a small request, NOT blocking and no rush. You hold fixtures/.../WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite.scala until 16:35 for the RecallGraph seal. When you are finished with that file, would you ping me? I want to run one ablation in it and every helper I need is private to that file.

WHAT I WANT TO MEASURE: how many gold targets are still hit at top-k with the LexicalTestResource synonym table REMOVED. That suite is the only chain in the repo reaching a RecallSignature from text, and its semantics come from a 14-entry hand-written table the suite itself labels 'a test resource, not evidence'.

I already measured a proxy from public data: 7 of the 14 entries actually bridge a recall stem to a source lemma the source does not already carry - boat->cano, misti->fog, raid->war, lift->carri, famili->rel, gui->man, tear->cri. Against only 42 distinct content stems across all ten paraphrases, that is about one content word in six reaching its node via a link we wrote, and they are exactly the paraphrase cases the task exists to demonstrate.

But that is how much the table COULD be doing, not how much the OUTCOME depends on it. The aligner has predicate, entity and structural terms too and may recover most targets without it. Only the ablation settles it.

I did not reconstruct the harness in a separate file deliberately: the cost model and canonicalisation are private, and a subtly different reproduction would produce an authoritative-looking wrong number. Better to wait for the file.

Entirely at your convenience - finish the seal first.
